items.description: Remove water-damaged laminate in living room
items.rationale: Covered under escape of water (2.4.2), as the laminate was physically damaged by water from a leaking pipe; removal is necessary preparatory work (7.1.7). Reference cases (61, 70) show this line is indemnified at about 32 EUR/m².

items.description: Supply & install premium oak laminate incl. impact sound insulation, living room
items.rationale: Only standard-grade replacement is indemnified (7.1.9); premium upgrade is not. Reference cases (61, 70) show standard laminate + insulation for 18 m² at about 1305–2675 EUR. Indemnity is capped at the cost of standard-grade material and installation for 18 m².

items.description: Supply and install skirting boards (premium solid oak, upgrade)
items.rationale: Skirting boards are building components (4.2.2) and were affected by water (damage description). Only standard-grade is indemnified (7.1.9); premium upgrade is not. Reference cases (61, 70) show 25 m at about 839 EUR for standard skirting.

items.description: Disassembly and disposal of damaged floor tiles in bathroom
items.rationale: Bathroom floor tiles were physically damaged by water (damage description), so removal is necessary preparatory work (7.1.7). Reference case 61: 6 m² at 336–366 EUR.

items.description: Supply & install premium large-format Italian porcelain tiles in bathroom incl. material
items.rationale: Only standard-grade replacement is indemnified (7.1.9); premium upgrade is not. Reference cases (61, 70) show 6 m² of standard tiles at 939–1109 EUR. Indemnity is capped at the cost of standard-grade tile and installation.
General cleaning is not a repair cost (7.1.8a) and is not indemnified unless specifically covered, which it is not. Reference cases (61, 65) show t = 0.

items.description: Paint lower wall after water damage incl. surface preparation
items.rationale: Lower wall was physically damaged by water (damage description); painting and prep are necessary repair (7.1.1b, 7.1.7). Reference cases (61, 70) show 20 m² at 618–858 EUR.
Ceiling was not affected by water (damage description); work beyond affected parts is excluded (7.1.5). Reference case 61: t below 181, possibly 0.
Hallway was not affected by water (damage description); work beyond affected parts is excluded (7.1.5). Reference case 61: t = 0.
